source_locator: Resolution 4205-05-2013, page 1 preamble (unopposed mayoral candidacy, Ordinance 20657-03-2013) and page 3 Section 6 (Betsy Price declared elected Mayor)
verification_note: The mayoral election was canceled because only one candidate filed. Ordinance 20657-03-2013 declared the unopposed candidate elected on the authority of Texas Election Code section 2.053, and Resolution 4205-05-2013 names Betsy Price as Mayor. No mayoral ballots were cast, so the vote count is 0 and the election_date is the scheduled general election date. Winner only is recorded because the contest was uncontested.
total_votes_basis: No mayoral votes were cast; the election was canceled and the sole candidate declared elected.
